title: Feasibility and Singularity in High-Order Safety-Critical Control for Quadrotor UAVs
summary: We study high-order safety-critical control of quadrotor teams under bounded inputs and pairwise collision-avoidance constraints. Squared-distance barriers may lose thrust effectiveness when the relative displacement is orthogonal to the available thrust directions, while nonsingular constraints may still be jointly infeasible under shared bounds. We characterize both phenomena through pairwise effectiveness and aggregate feasibility measures.
